title.zh: 「热 水 循环 泵」不改邢台报价前，订单要写明搅拌或只泵送这一行里的「0.4 m³ 在两类里都出现。」

h1.en: Hot Water Circulation Pump does not retitle the mixer pump or pump only purchase cells
h1.zh: 「热 水 循环 泵」并不改写邢台报价前，订单要写明搅拌或只泵送的格子

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for mixer pump or pump only purchase. The row to open is /products/integrated-mixer-pump. 0.4 m³ appears on both families. Diesel 40 remains the pump-only 4108 page. The electric mixer lists 45 kW plus 14 kW. The diesel mixer lists 4108 / 66–75 kW and three stone rows. Do not add a mixer motor to Electric 40 because the main kilowatts match. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai will not infer a mixer from a 0.4 m³ hopper. Electric 40, Electric 50, Diesel 40, Diesel 50 and Diesel 60 also print 0.4 m³ and do not list a mixer motor. The section title “Time for Hot Water to reach Fixture without Circulation Pump” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是邢台报价前，订单要写明搅拌或只泵送的数字。要打开的行是 /products/integrated-mixer-pump。0.4 m³ 在两类里都出现。柴油40仍然是只泵送的 4108 页。不要因为主千瓦相同就给电动40加上搅拌电机。电动搅拌泵列出 45 kW 加 14 kW。柴油搅拌泵列出 4108 / 66–75 kW 和三行石子。河北品锦机械（邢台）不会从 0.4 m³ 料斗推断出一台搅拌泵。电动40、电动50、柴油40、柴油50和柴油60也印 0.4 m³，并且不列搅拌电机。节标题「时间 用于 热 水 到 到达 用水点 无 循环 泵」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

heading.en: Time for Hot Water to reach Fixture without Circulation Pump
heading.zh: 时间 用于 热 水 到 到达 用水点 无 循环 泵

body.en: For mixer pump or pump only purchase, the heading “Time for Hot Water to reach Fixture without Circulation Pump” does not replace a cell. 0.4 m³ appears on both families. The diesel mixer lists 4108 / 66–75 kW and three stone rows. Electric 40, Electric 50, Diesel 40, Diesel 50 and Diesel 60 also print 0.4 m³ and do not list a mixer motor.
body.zh: 对邢台报价前，订单要写明搅拌或只泵送而言，标题「时间 用于 热 水 到 到达 用水点 无 循环 泵」并不替换任何格子。0.4 m³ 在两类里都出现。柴油搅拌泵列出 4108 / 66–75 kW 和三行石子。不要因为主千瓦相同就给电动40加上搅拌电机。

heading.zh: 热 水 循环 泵

body.en: mixer pump or pump only purchase is unchanged by the heading “Hot Water Circulation Pump”. Diesel 40 remains the pump-only 4108 page. Do not add a mixer motor to Electric 40 because the main kilowatts match.
body.zh: 邢台报价前，订单要写明搅拌或只泵送不因标题「热 水 循环 泵」而改动。柴油40仍然是只泵送的 4108 页。电动40、电动50、柴油40、柴油50和柴油60也印 0.4 m³，并且不列搅拌电机。

body.zh: 本节标题是「示例 - 所需 循环 体积 在 热 水 回 管道 管线」。邢台报价前，订单要写明搅拌或只泵送下面这些格子仍是印出来的。电动搅拌泵列出 45 kW 加 14 kW。河北品锦机械（邢台）不会从 0.4 m³ 料斗推断出一台搅拌泵。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/hot-water-circulation-return-pipe-d_1918.html。

question.en: Does “Time for Hot Water to reach Fixture without Circulation Pump” replace 0.4 m³ appears on both families?
question.zh: 「时间 用于 热 水 到 到达 用水点 无 循环 泵」会替换「0.4 m³ 在两类里都出现。」吗？

answer.en: No. 0.4 m³ appears on both families remains the printed wording for mixer pump or pump only purchase.
answer.zh: 不会。0.4 m³ 在两类里都出现。仍是邢台报价前，订单要写明搅拌或只泵送已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Diesel 40 remains the pump-only 4108 page belong on the mixer pump or pump only purchase row?
question.zh: 邢台报价前，订单要写明搅拌或只泵送这一行里，「柴油40仍然是只泵送的 4108 页。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/integrated-mixer-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/integrated-mixer-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Hot Water Circulation Pump” add to mixer pump or pump only purchase?
question.zh: 「热 水 循环 泵」给邢台报价前，订单要写明搅拌或只泵送增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/hot-water-circulation-return-pipe-d_1918.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/hot-water-circulation-return-pipe-d_1918.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside 0.4 m³ appears on both families?
question.zh: 「0.4 m³ 在两类里都出现。」旁边印了标价吗？
